new: MIDI and OSC, in and out. An output page (Shared dialog: Output page, or the room's link with &output) on a laptop or the PC sends the room's events and streams as MIDI (Chrome or Edge) and OSC (through a relay started with --osc-out and --osc-in).
Studio cards have Sends: a trigger cube (off until you turn it on; says who walked in or out), pressing and pointing at items, sequences.
Streams: people's heads and hands, items, trackers (sent by the relay itself), distances and heights, mapped to MIDI controllers or OSC.
Coming in: MIDI notes, controllers and clock, and OSC, press items, start or stop sequences, show or hide items and set the room's beat; a motion can follow the beat.
A new room format (networks-51): every device needs this release.
test: Start the relay on the PC with --lan --trackers --osc-out 127.0.0.1:9000 --osc-in 9001, open the output page in Chrome and pick a loopMIDI port; Test note should reach your software.
Opt a cube in, walk into it in a headset: the note and /studio/cube/<id>/enter with your name arrive; walking out ends the note.
Press an item with Sends, run a sequence, and send OSC /studio/press <id> or a mapped MIDI note back in.
Trackers as OSC: /room/tracker/<serial> at their own rate.
untested: Real MIDI and OSC software, loopMIDI on Windows, timing and jitter, everything in a headset.
A hidden output tab stops the scene's frames: keep it in front.
